# Research Built for Faster Decisions

The Media Technology Monitor (MTM) delivers more than 70 executive-level reports and infographics each year, covering the trends, platforms, behaviours, and audiences shaping Canadian media and technology. Available in both official languages, our research helps organizations quickly understand what’s changing — and what matters next.

[Request a Demo](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/fr/request-demo/)

MTM Junior

## YouTube Is The New Cable

Learn about how YouTube became the primary viewing destination for Canadian youth, with key details across different language markets, age groups, regions, viewership of other content and more.

## Research Across Every Corner of Canadian Media Behaviour

From streaming and social platforms to news consumption, gaming, AI, and connected devices, MTM reports uncover how Canadians engage with media and technology across generations and demographic groups.
